summary: Outlook stuck on loading profile after Windows update
resolution: Disabled a faulty PDF add-in via outlook.exe /safe, then restarted Outlook normally.

summary: VPN drops every 5 minutes on home Wi-Fi
resolution: Old VPN client version. Updated the client from the software portal and the connection stayed stable.

summary: Teams camera not detected in meetings
resolution: Camera privacy setting was off in Windows. Allowed camera access for desktop apps.
Print spooler stuck. Cleared the queue and re-added the printer from the company list.

summary: Outlook keeps asking for password after password change
resolution: Removed old MicrosoftOffice entries from Credential Manager and signed in again.

summary: OneDrive sync pending for project folder
resolution: File path was longer than allowed. Shortened folder names and sync resumed.
